checks.result: The archive contained only README.md and docker-scout.exe; no absolute parent-traversal or backslash member was present.
The archive matched the SHA-256 digest in GitHub release metadata.
The checksums asset matched its GitHub digest and repeated the exact archive digest.
The extracted executable reported NotSigned with no signer certificate.
The exact 1.24.0 executable was never run.
The archive, checksum, extracted executable and scratch tree were removed from verified system-temp custody.

retained_failures.note: PowerShell on this host lacked SHA256.HashData and Convert.ToHexString; fallback hashing produced the required metadata without acquiring or executing a candidate.
The report dereferenced a null signer certificate. A direct follow-up established Authenticode NotSigned; the scanner remained unexecuted.

decision.reason: Executing the candidate would weaken Source Gate 003's explicit Docker-signer requirement.
decision.safe_next_action: Assess the already installed Docker-signed Scout 1.20.4 binary as a distinct exact-hash preliminary scanner, including version-delta limitations, before any scan.
